jobs.description:
Are you looking to build a career in real estate finance? Wanaka Partners is looking for a 
Property Finance Administrator to join our 
team. After a thorough onboarding period where we'll familiarise you with our working methods and organisation, you'll work hand in hand with our Property Managers on the financial and administrative management of a portfolio of buildings. If you're rigorous, detail-oriented, and enjoy keeping numbers and clients in sync, this role is for you.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Financial administration: Manage the financial administration of your assigned buildings using our dedicated property and accounting software. 

• Rent & charges collection: Call in rents and common charges contractually due from tenants or co-owners. 

• Invoice & payment control: Control supplier invoicing and rent/charge payments, index rents, and track budgets and bank guarantees. 

• Cost allocation: Distribute shared costs across owners and tenants using allocation keys. 

• Client reporting: Report periodically on the accounting situation to clients. 

• Accounting support: Provide broader support across accounting operations for the team.  

 
 

What makes this role exciting?
 
 

• Impact: Your accuracy and follow-through directly support smooth, transparent operations for owners and tenants alike. 

• Growth opportunities: This role is a strong stepping stone toward more senior finance and accounting positions in property management. 

• Continuous learning: Benefit from an intensive, hands-on onboarding and ongoing training within the company. 

• Team spirit: Work in close, daily collaboration with our Property Managers.  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• A background in accounting, or equivalent experience. 

• Fluent in 
French and Dutch, with very good 
English (B2 minimum). 

• Proactive and comfortable maintaining regular contact with clients, suppliers, and colleagues. 

• Flexible, solution-oriented, rigorous, and disciplined with deadlines. 

• Able to work both independently and as part of a team. 

• Comfortable with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint); knowledge of accounting software is a plus.  

 
 

Wa(n)na join our team?
 

Apply today and grow with Wanaka Partners! Send your CV and a cover letter via the contact form below or directly to jobs@wanakapartners.com.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
To strengthen our Quality Team we are looking for a: QUALITY ENGINEER

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. CLdN’s cargo and multimodal services have a Europe-wide reach using CLdN’s extensive network of ships, terminals and equipment. CLdN’s 3,000 employees ensure that it fulfills its mission: to excel as an integrated provider of maritime links.  
 

Are you looking for the next step in your payroll career?

• You play a key role in the execution, control and continuous improvement of payroll processes. Working closely with the Payroll Lead, you independently manage end-to-end payroll activities for assigned countries and can take ownership of international payroll operations when required. 

Your profile
 
 

•   Minimum 5 years of payroll experience, preferably in an international or multi-country environment.  

• Solid understanding of payroll operations, tax legislation, social security regulations and labour law requirements.  

• Proven ability to independently manage payroll processes and complex payroll cases.  

• Experience working with external payroll providers and HRIS/payroll systems.  

• Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.  

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders across different countries.  

• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented mindset.  

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an asset.

Responsibilities

• Develop software components using .NET Framework and .NET Core.
• Design scalable and maintainable solutions in collaboration with the architecture team.
• Provide technical coaching and mentorship to team members.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices.
• Analyze functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Optimize system performance while ensuring security and maintainability.
• Evaluate and integrate new technologies that align with organizational objectives.

Requirements

• 8+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework.
• 3+ years of experience with ASP.NET Web API, MVC, and REST APIs including Swagger/OpenAPI.
• 3+ years of experience with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
• You possess experience with Authentication/Authorization protocols such as JWT, OIDC, and claims-based identity.
• You have a strong background in Unit Testing and Integration Testing.
• You bring a structured, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to lead technically.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Proactive approach to evaluating emerging technologies.
